pages.text: The Plasma Chain is the $(4)ultimate form of fuel$(0): ordinary fuel is condensed step by step into plasma fuel rods, made only for the Fusion Reactor.$(br2)$(bold)Upstream:$(0) its "activated crystals" come from the exhausted-fuel activator → centrifuge route — that belongs to "Secrets of Life".$(br2)$(bold)Three steps on this chain, one entry each:$(0)$(li)$(l:akaishi:plasma_fractionator)Activated Fractionator$(/l): splits activated crystals into components$(li)$(l:akaishi:plasma_aggregator)Fusion Fuel Aggregator$(/l): condenses components into plasma$(li)$(l:akaishi:plasma_filler)Plasma Filler$(/l): pours plasma into fusion rods$(br2)The finished rods feed straight into "$(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l)".

$(bold)A dedicated line:$(0) plasma travels only through the $(4)Plasma Pipe / Plasma Fuel Tank$(0) — ordinary fluid pipes won't touch it. Lay it from aggregator to filler first and not a drop spills.$(br2)All three rods carry $(4)6 trillion$(0) energy each; they differ only in temper — how to pick and burn them: $(l:akaishi:plasma_rods)Plasma Fuel Rods$(/l).
The three machines and the finished rods each have their own entry above; the $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l) is where they get burned.
